question: Does the reading stage produce the same per-question verdicts twice at temperature 0?

before.cause: competitor-retrieval.yml forwarded no TEMPERATURE, so createLlmFromEnv built the reader with temperature: null and the request carried no sampling field.

residual.value: 19 of 379 verdicts move on byte-identical prompts (5.0%)
residual.note: That is the judge sampling its own verdict, which pinning the reader temperature cannot remove. A 20-question arm carries about one such flip, so 0 is inside the floor and 4 was the unpinned rate.

withdrawn.reason: read at temp=default, and the control arm's own two readings differed by more than the inter-arm difference
